surfaces.name: Agent Control
surfaces.description: A physical control surface for autonomous agents. Watch every session at a glance, approve or reject, pause and resume, start a task.

controls.label: Agent 1
controls.description: Shows the status of one agent session. Press to select it; the command pads then act on it. Long-press dismisses a finished session.

controls.label: Select 1
controls.description: Lit while this track is selected. Press to select it.

controls.label: Approve
controls.description: Approve the selected session's pending request. Flashes while the selected session is waiting for you. Never pressed for you.

controls.label: Reject
controls.description: Reject the selected session's pending request.

controls.label: Pause
controls.description: Pause the selected session, if its agent supports pausing.

controls.label: Retry
controls.description: Retry the selected failed or cancelled session.

controls.label: Continue
controls.description: Tell the selected session to continue. Edit the text in the inspector.

controls.label: Run tests
controls.description: Start this task on the selected agent (or the first agent that can). Edit the task text in the inspector.

args.task: Run the test suite and report failures

controls.label: Review diff
controls.description: Start this task on the selected agent (or the first agent that can). Edit the task text in the inspector.

controls.label: Summarize
controls.description: Start this task on the selected agent (or the first agent that can). Edit the task text in the inspector.

controls.label: Run Agent Demo
controls.description: Start four simulated agents: tool use, an approval to answer, a pause to try, a failure to retry. Nothing real runs.

controls.label: Reset demo
controls.description: Stop the simulated agents and clear their sessions.

controls.label: Open Agents
controls.description: Show the Agents section in the desktop app: sessions, logs, adapters.

surfaces.name: Development
surfaces.description: Build, test and ship. Pads pulse while a command runs, then turn green or flash red.

controls.label: VS Code
controls.description: Launch VS Code (`code` must be on your PATH, or the app name on macOS).

controls.label: Docker
controls.description: Placeholder: harmless echo. Replace with `docker compose up`.

controls.label: Tests
controls.description: Safe demo: sleeps 2s then succeeds. Pad pulses yellow, then turns green.

controls.label: Deploy
controls.description: Safe demo: sleeps 2s then succeeds. Replace with your deploy script.

controls.label: Failing Task
controls.description: Demonstrates the error state: exits with code 1, pad flashes red.

controls.label: Commit
controls.description: Safe demo. Replace with your commit script.

surfaces.name: Accessibility
surfaces.description: Fewer, larger targets in colour-coded groups. A predictable, low-effort way to drive the computer.

controls.label: HOME
controls.description: Go to the start of the page (Alt+Home).

controls.label: HELP
controls.description: Open the help page: call, message, lights, music.

controls.label: CALL
controls.description: Start a call with your phone app (tel:). Edit the number in the inspector.

controls.label: MESSAGE
controls.description: Start a text message (sms:). Edit the recipient in the inspector.
